properties.name: Walker
properties.date_note: Village incorporated Mar 10, 1896; first train Aug 8, 1896; named for lumberman Thomas B. Walker by founder Patrick McGarry.
properties.notes: Railroad/logging + resort town; county seat of Cass County.

properties.name: Federal Dam
properties.date_note: Grew around the USACE Leech Lake Dam; post office 1910, incorporated as a village 1911.
properties.notes: Dam/company town, paired with the Leech Lake Dam.

properties.name: Boy River
properties.date_note: Community grew in the 1880s; post office, railway station and general stores by 1910; incorporated 1922.
properties.notes: Logging/railroad village on the Boy River.

properties.name: Onigum
properties.date_note: Leech Lake Agency opened after the 1855 treaty on the south shore of Leech Lake at Onigum; agency moved ~2.5 mi across the bay in 1899, then to Cass Lake in 1922. No community founding date verified.
properties.notes: Agency/mission community, not a railroad town. Pointer only; Old/New Agency building sites not survey-verified.

properties.name: Cass Lake
properties.date_note: Established 1898 with the Great Northern Railway; originally 'Tuller', renamed Cass Lake by Mar 1899. Later agency HQ and tribal HQ.
properties.notes: Labeled neighbor: the city polygon was verified 0-intersects with HUC8 07010102 (synthesis §4.4); this point also falls outside the clip.

properties.name: Bena
properties.date_note: Railway village, 1880s; name from the Ojibwe word for partridge; post office 1898. No exact founding/incorporation year verified.
properties.notes: Clip result: IN the watershed (point-in-polygon vs HUC8 07010102), contrary to the earlier 'likely outside' expectation; corroborated by synthesis §4.4, which lists Bena among the 9 incorporated places intersecting the watershed.

properties.name: Ball Club
properties.date_note: One of the eleven Reservation communities (MN Indian Affairs). Individual founding date not verified.
properties.notes: Present-day Reservation community; founding history needs Band sources. Outside the watershed (neighbor).

properties.name: Inger
properties.date_note: One of the eleven Reservation communities (MN Indian Affairs). Individual founding date not verified.
properties.notes: Present-day Reservation community; founding history needs Band sources. Outside the watershed (neighbor).

properties.name: Squaw Lake
properties.date_note: One of the eleven Reservation communities (MN Indian Affairs). Individual founding date not verified. Not to be confused with Squaw Lake (now Little Woman Lake) in Cass County.
properties.notes: Present-day Reservation community; founding history needs Band sources. Outside the watershed (neighbor).

properties.name: Sugar Point
properties.date_note: One of the eleven Reservation communities (MN Indian Affairs). Individual founding date not verified. Site of the Battle of Sugar Point, Oct 5, 1898.
properties.notes: Point placed at the GNIS Sugar Point cape (47.1694, -94.3200) on the north shore of Leech Lake; community center approximate. Present-day Reservation community; founding history needs Band sources.

properties.name: Oak Point
properties.date_note: One of the eleven Reservation communities (MN Indian Affairs). Formerly Squaw Point, renamed Oak Point in 1995. Individual founding date not verified.
properties.notes: Point placed at the geographic center of Squaw/Oak Point, Leech Lake (47.1693, -94.5740, NYBG herbarium georeference of the GNIS point); community center approximate. Present-day Reservation community; founding history needs Band sources.

properties.name: Mission
properties.date_note: One of the eleven Reservation communities (MN Indian Affairs). Individual founding date not verified. Community lies west of Cass Lake, between lakes Andrusia and Cass.
properties.notes: Point placed approximately at the Mission Catholic Cemetery / Hwy 8 area, Ten Lake Township (47.4306, -94.6503, Minnesota Genealogical Society); no GNIS populated-place coordinate verified for Mission itself — exact community center needs Band confirmation. Outside the watershed (neighbor).

properties.name: Pennington
properties.date_note: One of the eleven Reservation communities (MN Indian Affairs); also called Cass River. Individual founding date not verified.
properties.notes: Unincorporated community 9.5 mi NE of Cass Lake; GNIS feature ID 657774 (47.48361, -94.48000). Present-day Reservation community; founding history needs Band sources. Outside the watershed (neighbor).

properties.name: Smokey Point
properties.date_note: One of the eleven Reservation communities (MN Indian Affairs). Individual founding date not verified.
properties.notes: Point placed approximately at Smokey Point Rd, Walker Bay south shore; community center approximate. Present-day Reservation community; founding history needs Band sources.
